strategies.name: Buy and hold (benchmark)
strategies.rule: Equal weight in every stock, never sold.

strategies.name: Drop 25% from 52-week high
strategies.rule: Buy the first day 25% below the 52-week high; sell at that high or after 12 months.

strategies.name: 12-1 momentum
strategies.rule: Monthly: top 10% by 12-month return skipping the last month; hold 1 month.

strategies.name: Near 52-week high
strategies.rule: Monthly: the 10% closest to their 52-week high; hold 1 month.

strategies.name: Short-term reversal (RSI-2)
strategies.rule: Buy when 2-day RSI < 10 above the 200-day average; sell above the 5-day average or after 10 days.

strategies.name: Covered call (buy-write)
strategies.rule: Own the stock and sell a 1-month call 2% above the price, every month. Option prices modelled.

strategies.name: Cash-secured put-write
strategies.rule: Sell a 1-month at-the-money put each month, fully cash-secured. Option prices modelled.

strategies.name: Collar
strategies.rule: Own the stock, buy a 1-month put 5% below and sell a call 5% above, every month. Option prices modelled.
